The Department of Veterans Affairs intends to solicit offers to provide Hospital Electric Air Beds. 
The Solicitation will result in the award of one (1) single contract. The resulting contract will be a firm fixed price contract. The applicable NAICS code will be 339113, Surgical Appliance and Supplies Manufacturing.
The solicitation will be posted to SAM.gov contract opportunities and response to the solicitation will be electronically.
